What can you expect as a truck driver? - A salary of up to €500 gross per week for working 2 days; - You return home after every shift, leaving you with plenty of time for family and friends; - A company that thinks along with you and takes your preferences into account; - The possibility of a permanent contract; - Pension contributions in accordance with the applicable collective labour agreement (CAO); - Paid vacation days based on the number of hours you work.
